verdict.rationale: Gitea's documentation describes it as a free, MIT-licensed, self-hosted Git service with unlimited users and repositories, and the self-hosted product covers the core feature set: repos, code review, issues, Actions and packages. The docs also cover easy deployment across Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD and Kubernetes, multiple databases, and both single-server and replication setups. Independent hands-on reports back this up, describing single-binary installs, smooth Docker setups for teams of 8 to 45, $5 VPS and low-power hardware deployments, and simple binary-swap upgrades.
